mapper.update: MERGE /* @SQLID=SUB0504_02-01#SQL002 */ INTO T_IPO_PO_EDELIV_AGRMNT T USING ( SELECT #{butenCode} AS BUTEN_CODE, TO_NUMBER(#{accountNumber}) AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER, CASE WHEN #{agreementDate} IS NOT NULL AND #{agreementDate} != '' THEN TO_DATE(#{agreementDate}, 'YYYY/MM/DD') ELSE NULL END AS EDELIV_AGREEMENT_DATE, #{agreementKbn} AS EDELIV_AGREEMENT_KBN, #{userId} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL ) A ON ( T.BUTEN_CODE = A.BUTEN_CODE AND T.ACCOUNT_NUMBER = A.ACCOUNT_NUMBER ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.EDELIV_AGREEMENT_DATE = A.EDELIV_AGREEMENT_DATE, T.EDELIV_AGREEMENT_KBN = A.EDELIV_AGREEMENT_KBN, T.UPDATE_TIME = IFA_DATE_UTIL.IFA_GET_DATE, T.UPDATE_USER = A.USER_ID, T.SYS_ID = 'SUB0504' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( BUTEN_CODE, ACCOUNT_NUMBER, EDELIV_AGREEMENT_KBN, EDELIV_AGREEMENT_DATE, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, SYS_ID ) VALUES ( A.BUTEN_CODE, A.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, A.EDELIV_AGREEMENT_KBN, A.EDELIV_AGREEMENT_DATE, IFA_DATE_UTIL.IFA_GET_DATE, A.USER_ID, IFA_DATE_UTIL.IFA_GET_DATE, A.USER_ID, 'SUB0504' )
